test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Negative'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank number 1 would be** "negative".**
 
• **The context of the sentence **is about myths surrounding the health impacts of milk.
 
• So, we are discussing potential adverse or** "negative"** effects that these myths suggest, which is why "negative" is the most fitting choice.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *There are so many myths about the **negative** impacts of milk on health. Changing how much milk you drink because of (2) _____ myths may mean you are unnecessarily restricting this (3)______ nutritious drink. Australians often restrict dairy foods when they try to (4) weight believing them to be fattening. While dairy products naturally contain fat there are many reduced fat products (5) _______.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are less appropriate:
 
 
• **"Kind" **- This word is typically used to describe someone's character or behavior as considerate or benevolent. Here, it doesn't fit well because we're talking about potential health effects, not characteristics or behaviors.
 
• **"Welcoming" **- This adjective describes an inviting or friendly environment or attitude. It does not fit in this context because we're discussing perceived health impacts, not attitudes or environments.
 
• **"Impolite"** - This word describes behavior that's not respectful or courteous. It is not suitable here because we're discussing health impacts, not manners or politeness.
